title: Israel's election too close to call. And, the Ebola outbreak reaches grim milestone
description: Israeli voters turned out in record numbers, and the results remain too close to call. And, more than 10,000 people have been infected with Ebola since the outbreak was first declared in May.

title: Senate candidates built up massive campaign war chests with out-of-state donations
description: In several competitive U.S. Senate contests, candidates have built healthy campaign accounts with out-of-state donations. But the messages to those donors is very different from the one back at home.

title: Why many student voters have a right to choose where to register to vote
description: Student voters studying outside their hometown have a right to choose where they register to vote. Advocates say a Montana legal fight is a reminder of a misunderstanding of those students' rights.

title: Here's how Democrats in Congress are preparing for election fraud claims
description: Congressional Democrats are working with good governance groups to create an action plan for any potential claims of election fraud.

title: How a lifelong Republican came to lead the data center battle in Ohio
description: In Ohio, many people are displeased with the state's rapid buildout of data centers. It's a hot issue in the midterms, as political candidates from both parties try to ease voter concerns.

title: Minnesota becomes battleground as political clashes shape Senate race
description: Minnesota has become a flashpoint in the political dispute between President Trump and Democrats. Clashes over immigration and recent accusations of fraud are spilling into the U.S. Senate race.

title: A judge halted D.C. golf course renovations. Trump says they'll still start next month
description: A federal judge has barred the government from clearing more trees or making other alterations to D.C.'s East Potomac Park without proper notice. Trump says his administration will appeal.

title: Democrats have a midterm edge, poll shows. And, Israelis vote in high-stakes election
description: Democrats are still holding a slight edge with Election Day a week away, according to a new NPR/PBS News/Marist poll. And, Israelis are casting their votes in an election that could change leadership.

title: Polymarket has investigated 'dozens' of election-related cases
description: The prediction market has hired a former FBI official to make sure political insiders don't use the platform for profit from confidential election information.

title: Democrats still poised to make gains, but poll shows warning signs for just how many
description: Democrats hold significant advantages going into Election Day, according to a new NPR/PBS News/Marist poll. But lagging enthusiasm among key groups is just one indicator that gains may not come easy.
